process_issues.description: Every Bash invocation failed before running with 'apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied'. This included `git status --porcelain`, `git rev-parse HEAD` and `gh pr view 231 --json ...`. The PR diff, file list, intent and head SHA could not be read, and neither freshness assertion could run.

No reviewers were spawned: subagents share the same Bash sandbox and could not fetch the diff either. From the session-start git status, the PR touches at least .claude/agents/{architecture-explainer,review-correctness}.md and .claude/skills/{address-review-comments,pr-ci-review,pr-description}/SKILL.md, and it adds .claude/skills/pr-ci-review/REVIEW.md. Whether it touches anything outside the config-restore set is unknown, so a partial review was not attempted. This PR has NOT been reviewed; re-run once the sandbox can start.
